source.title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
source.author: nb-t

title.zh: Lean 4广义黎曼猜想形式化证明精简版
title.en: Lean 4 GRH Proof: A More Compact Edition

excerpt.zh: Lean 4广义黎曼猜想证明项目发布精简版本，将形式化代码从约30万行压缩至约7.6万行；机器检查通过，但尚未经过数学家通读。
excerpt.en: A compact Lean 4 GRH proof edition reduces the formalization from about 300,000 lines to 76,000, but it has not been reviewed line by line by a mathematician.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Lean 4广义黎曼猜想证明，代码缩短逾七成
text.en: Lean 4 GRH proof, in a substantially shorter edition

text.zh: 一项由 Anthropic 同事与 Claude 合作整理的 Lean 4广义黎曼猜想证明项目，新增了更紧凑的代码版本。仓库称，精简版约有7.6万行，原有便于阅读的版本约30万行；两版覆盖相同的五个定理。
text.en: A Lean 4 formalization of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH), prepared with Anthropic colleagues and Claude, now has a more compact edition. The repository says the compact version contains about 76,000 lines, compared with roughly 300,000 in the readable edition. Both editions cover the same five theorems.

text.zh: 项目以 Lean 4 和 Mathlib 为基础，目标包括黎曼猜想，以及狄利克雷 L 函数情形下的广义黎曼猜想。仓库将其定位为研究成果，不维护，也不接受贡献。构建需要指定版本的 Lean 与 Mathlib；项目说明，在12核、24 GB内存环境中，构建约需一至两小时，缺少 Mathlib 缓存时还会更久。
text.en: Built on Lean 4 and Mathlib, the project states results for the Riemann Hypothesis and the GRH for Dirichlet L-functions. Its maintainers describe it as a research artifact that is not maintained and is not accepting contributions. Building requires specified Lean and Mathlib versions; the repository estimates one to two hours on a 12-core machine with 24 GB of memory, and longer if the Mathlib cache is unavailable.

text.zh: 机器检查不等于数学界审阅
text.en: Machine checking is not the same as mathematical review

text.zh: 精简代码可以降低检视和复现的规模，但行数减少本身并不能证明论证更容易理解，也不能替代独立审查。仓库称证明已通过机器检查，并列出所用公理；同时明确说明，尚无数学家从头到尾阅读过证明，也没有配套论文。因此，这项工作的外部数学验证程度仍是关键未决问题。
text.en: Fewer lines may make inspection and reproduction more manageable, but code size alone does not show that an argument is easier to understand or replace independent scrutiny. The repository reports that the proof passed machine checks and lists the axioms used. It also says that no mathematician has read the proof through and that no accompanying paper exists. The extent of independent mathematical validation therefore remains an open and important question.
